title: fix(types,plugin-dashboard)!: retire `DrillDownConfig.report`'s `{ name }` reference arm on all three faces, refused by name (objectui#11517)
body:
Fixes #11517

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Triage's ruling `5962814975` on the card: **retire** `DrillDownConfig.report`'s `{ name }` reference arm on the TypeScript, tolerant and strict faces, refused by name, with no alias window. The `domain:ui` reviewer's note `5963125397` is folded in: the pre-9.0 `objectName` drill report, which the tolerant face read as this arm, is now refused on that face with a message naming its retirement (objectui#11506).

## What changes

- **TypeScript face (`@object-ui/types`).** `DrillDownConfig.report` goes from `SpecReportInput | { name: string }` to `SpecReportInput`. The JSDoc that described the reference is replaced by a retirement paragraph. `tsc` now refuses a bare `{ name }` because the spec requires other members (`label` first). The per-block shapes `ObjectPivotDrillDownConfig` and `ObjectMetricDrillDownConfig` inherit this.
- **Both zod faces.** `DrillDownReportSchema` (`zod/data-display.zod.ts`) is no longer a union. It is `stripImportedDefaults(SpecReportSchema)` with two additions, and each one names a retirement:
  - `objectName: aliasKeyRefusal('objectName', 'dataset', 'this drill report', …)` is a declared refusal. Its message starts with the spec's own sentence ("Did you mean `objectName` → `dataset`?") and names objectui#11506. This is the reviewer's note: the tolerant face now refuses the pre-9.0 form by name too.
  - `refuseRetiredDrillReportReference` is a `superRefine` with `when: () => true`, following the `requireRecordSource` precedent. When a parsed value's only report member is `name`, it adds a `custom` issue with `params.code: 'DRILL_REPORT_REFERENCE_RETIRED'`. The message names objectui#11517 and the dataset-bound form to write instead.
  - The strict face is derived from the tolerant mirror, so it inherits both additions. No strict-face code changed.
  - `DrillDownReportZodType` stays a by-reference type, for the TS7056 reason `ReportNodeZodType` gives. In the rebuilt `dist`, emit prints it by name at 3 sites in `data-display.zod.d.ts`, 2 in `objectql.zod.d.ts` and 4 in `index.zod.d.ts`. PR objectui#11516's body reports the same counts; I did not re-measure BASE.
- **The drawer draws the same thing.** The only change in `DrillDownDrawer.tsx` is a comment: the `report` prop doc now names the two retired forms. `isDatasetBoundReport` and the render path are byte-identical.
- **Docs.** In `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx`, section "Drilling into a report", the paragraph that said the tolerant face still accepts the old form, and that a `{ "name": "…" }` reference "is declared too", is replaced. The section now lists the two retired forms and what each face does with them. The section's JSON example is unchanged.
- **Changesets.** New: `.changeset/11517-drill-report-name-retired.md`, `@object-ui/types` minor, with a BREAKING line, FROM/TO, and the accept-set change stated per face. Dated notes are appended to `7352-drill-down-config-mirror` and `11506-drill-drawer-runtime-filter` (sweep below).

## Before and after, per face (measured at BASE `8366accd1` and at head)

The zod columns come from a throwaway vitest probe, deleted and never committed. The TypeScript column comes from a scratch `tsc` program that restates BASE's member type (`SpecReportInput | { name: string }`) beside head's; refusals are TS2741 or TS2322.

| value | TypeScript | tolerant (`safeValidateSchema`, `objectui validate`) | strict (`StrictAnyComponentSchema`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{ name: 'saved_report' }` | accepted → refused | valid, as `{ name }` → refused, named (`DRILL_REPORT_REFERENCE_RETIRED`) | valid → refused, named |
| pre-9.0 `{ name, objectName, type, columns: [{ field }] }` | refused → refused | valid, stripped to `{ name }` → refused at `report.objectName` (`invalid_type`, names objectui#11506) | refused (`unrecognized_keys`: `objectName`) → refused at `report.objectName` (`invalid_type`, names objectui#11506) |
| `{ name: 'pipeline', columns: [] }` | accepted → refused | valid, stripped to `{ name }` → refused (the spec's own issues) | refused → refused |
| incomplete inline matrix (no `values`) | accepted → accepted (`values` is a spec refinement, enforced at runtime only) | valid, stripped to `{ name }` → refused, in the spec's words (`a report needs dataset + values`) | refused → refused (same message) |
| `{ name: 42 }` | refused → refused | refused → refused, now also named | refused → refused, now also named |
| dataset-bound summary report | accepted → accepted | valid → valid, every key kept | valid → valid, every key kept |

Each "valid → refused" cell on the tolerant face was a document `objectui validate` reported VALID, and the drawer then listed records for it.

## Pins (the ruling's two, plus the reviewer's note)

1. **`report: { name }` is refused on all three faces:** `packages/types/src/__tests__/drill-down-report-name-retired-11517.test.ts` (new).
   - TypeScript: `@ts-expect-error` on `DrillDownConfig`, `ObjectPivotDrillDownConfig` and `ObjectMetricDrillDownConfig`, and on a non-literal value typed `{ name: string }`. A type-level `Assert` checks that `{ name: string }` is not assignable to the report type.
   - zod: five doors (the mirror, tolerant `object-pivot`, tolerant `chart`, strict `object-pivot`, strict `chart`). Each must answer with exactly one `custom` issue at the report, carrying `DRILL_REPORT_REFERENCE_RETIRED`, and the message must name `objectui#11517` and `dataset`.
   - Boundary: an incomplete inline report is refused in the spec's own words and is not flagged as the retired reference.
2. **The dataset-bound inline report still validates and still draws through the real drawer.**
   - Validates: the same file, on all five doors, with every key kept.
   - Draws: `apps/console/src/__tests__/drillDownReport.nameRetired-11517.test.tsx` (new). One `object-pivot` document validates on the strict and tolerant faces. Its `drillDown.report` then goes through the real `DrillDownDrawer` over the real `report` registration of `@object-ui/plugin-report`. The drawer issues `queryDataset('deals_ds', …)` with `runtimeFilter: { stage: 'Won' }` and no `find`. A second case checks that a stored `{ name }` is refused on both faces and that the real drawer still lists the records for it, as it did before the retirement.
3. **Reviewer's note:** the same types file, on all five doors. The pre-9.0 form must answer `invalid_type` at `objectName` with a message naming `objectui#11506`, and no reference issue.

## Corpus re-judged (every fixture that authored `report: { name }`)

| file | verdict | now |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/drill-down-config-mirror-7352.test.ts` | **tested the arm**: two ACCEPTED rows, "a named report reference" and `{ name, columns: [] }` ("which the reference arm accepts") | both re-judged to REFUSED rows (path `report`). The `{ name: 42 }` row is relabelled. The docblock's "two structural forms" becomes one. |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/drill-down-report-dataset-bound-11506.test.ts` | **tested the arm**: `reference: DrillDownConfig` was accepted, and a test said the tolerant face "falls to the reference arm" | `@ts-expect-error` on the reference. The tolerant test is re-judged to a named refusal at `report.objectName`. The strict assertion moves from `unrecognized_keys` to `invalid_type` at `objectName`, since `objectName` is now declared. The header is updated. |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/drill-down-per-block-10685.test.ts` (4 sites) | **convenient value**: the pivot accept control, the chart and `object-data-table` member refusals, and the `object-data-table` zod refusal | dataset-bound report. The refusals now concern the member, not its value. |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-chart-undeclared-keys-8885.test.ts` | **convenient value**: the chart drill refuses `report` as a key | dataset-bound report |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-metric-drill-down-config-9002.test.ts` | **convenient value**: accept control | dataset-bound report |
| `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/ObjectPivotTable.drillDownRefusal-10685.test.tsx` | **convenient value**: accept control | dataset-bound report |
| `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/objectMetricDrillDownMembers-8071.test.tsx` | already dataset-bound; no `{ name }` | untouched, ran green |
| `packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` | already dataset-bound | untouched, ran green |

**Producer census (H1): zero non-test producers.**
- objectui at BASE: `drillDown` appears in 0 files under `examples/`, 1 under `content/` (this docs page, whose example is dataset-bound), 0 under `docs/`, 0 in non-test `apps/console/src`, and 20 in non-test `packages/*/src`. None of those 20 authors a `report:` object literal.
- objectstack `origin/main` `535d1d25`: 0 `drillDown` files under `examples/`, and 0 `report: { name` literals there.
- Controls that fire: 20 `drillDown` files in non-test `packages/*/src`; the docs page's `report: {` literal hits the report-literal matcher; 8 test files hit the bare-`{ name }` matcher; 6 `object-metric` files in objectstack's `examples/`; 4 `report: { name` hits in objectstack's `packages/`.
- The cloud repo is not in this container: NOT MEASURED there.

## Readers (H4): no edit needed beyond one comment

- **Method.** A TypeScript language-service `findReferences` on `DrillDownConfig.report`. The program is 1524 non-test source files from every workspace that depends on `@object-ui/types`, with `@object-ui/*` mapped to source, and it was run at BASE and at head.
- **What it found.**
  - `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx`: `drillDown?.report as` a `Record` of `string` to `unknown` (or `undefined`).
  - `ObjectPivotTable.tsx`: `report={drillDown?.report}`.
  - The `object-data-table` tombstone, `report?: never`.
  - Both readers hand the value to `DrillDownDrawer`'s `report?:` prop, a `Record` of `string` to `unknown` and need nothing. `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` type-check is green against the rebuilt types `dist`.
- **The drawer.** `isDatasetBoundReport` takes `unknown`, so it needs nothing either. Only the prop's doc comment named the arm.
- **Control.** A text grep finds the same two sites.

## Contract notes

1. **Accept set.** For JSON values, both zod faces now accept exactly what the spec's `ReportSchema` accepts. The two additions only add an issue to values the spec already refuses.
   - One edge, not reachable from JSON: an explicit `objectName: undefined` is now accepted by the optional `never` member, where the spec's strictness refused the key. JSON cannot carry `undefined`, and the TS face still refuses `objectName`.
   - Every `retirementTombstone` and `aliasKeyRefusal` in this package has the same edge.
2. **Why `objectName` is a declared member rather than a key test in the refinement.** zod hands a check the object it built, not the input, so an undeclared key is invisible there. The first cut tested the key inside the refinement, and on the probe it never fired.
3. **A message change on the strict face, with the same accept set.** For the pre-9.0 form, the strict face used to report `unrecognized_keys` at the report. It now reports `invalid_type` at `report.objectName`, and the message starts with the spec's own sentence.
4. **The issue an author reads for `{ name }`.** The named issue sits after the spec's own `report.label` issue, because zod reports shape issues before checks.
5. **Not changed:**
   - `ReportNodeSchema.report`, the `report` node, is still the plain spec schema.
   - The drawer's render and its join rule.
   - `object-data-table`'s `report` tombstone.
   - `ChartSchema.drillDown`.

## Verification (final head `ecf5fd38`)

Every source file is byte-identical from `4b461bfa` on: `ecf5fd38` adds only the 3 `.changeset` files. The runs below were taken on that tree.
- **Type-checks.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check`, all three legs: exit 0.
  - First run: red, TS2322 ×2, from a control in my own new pin. Fixed before commit.
  - `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists all 6 changed types test files.
- **`pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard run type-check`**, after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build`: exit 0. Its `tsconfig.test.json` lists `ObjectPivotTable.drillDownRefusal-10685`.
- **`pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check`**: exit 0. The console closure (35 packages) was built first. `tsc --listFiles` lists the new console pin.
- **`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/`**: 345 files, 9180 passed. `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **One vitest run over 27 files, 906 tests passed** (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). The set is every suite that names a changed file by path:
  - 5 console pins: the three `drillDownReport.*` pins (the new one included), `registry-inputs-spec-parity` and `unfulfilled-chart-stubs-8760`;
  - cli `unfulfilled-chart-stubs-retired-8760` and `registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859`;
  - plugin-grid `columnEmitBoundary-6004`;
  - 10 plugin-dashboard drawer and drill suites;
  - 9 `scripts/__tests__` suites that read a changed file by path.
- **Gates, exit 0 at head:**
  - `check:control-bytes`
  - `check:new-line-citations` (0 new)
  - `check-changeset-presence`
  - `changeset:check` (no major)
  - `check:changeset-claims`, report-only. It named 14 pending entries that mention a touched file; each was read, and none mentions the drill report.
  - `check:pending-changeset-literals`
  - `check:spec-symbols`
  - `check:doc-types`
  - `check:doc-fences`
  - `check:doc-snippets` (777 of 777 blocks)
  - `check:doc-examples`
  - `check:test-path-roots`
  - `check:phantom-deps`
  - `check:component-surface-parity`, report-only
- **eslint over the 11 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files:** 0 errors and 34 warnings, all on lines this diff does not touch. The narrowing is proven three ways:
  1. **Population:** `eslint.config.js` lints every `**/*.{ts,tsx}` outside `dist`, `.next`, `node_modules`, `public` and `.source`, and three named build artefacts. No package has its own config.
  2. **Count:** `--format json` returned 11 files, none ignored.
  3. **Invariance:** there is no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. So this diff cannot move the verdict of an untouched file.
- **NOT MEASURED:**
  - `check:sdui-registration-pins`, which needs the console bundle (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, exit 2). No registration input moved, so it is not owed.
  - The `Spec Main Shape Gate` (TS7056 against objectstack `main`). It belongs to CI.

## Reverse verification

Each leg ran from the committed head through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutation was proven on disk (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed), and each restore was proven: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The prediction was written before each run.
- **A1, drop the `{ name }` refinement.** Predicted: the 6 named-`{ name }` rows go red and the rest stay green. Observed: 6 failed, 73 passed.
- **A2, un-declare `objectName`** (renamed in the extension). Predicted: 5 doors plus 2 rows in the 11506 pin. Observed: 7 failed, 72 passed.
- **A3, put `| { name: string }` back on the TS face.** Predicted: 5 × TS2578 (unused `@ts-expect-error`) and 1 × TS2344 (the `Assert`). Observed: exactly those, plus TS2322 `LedgerMismatch` in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`. The parity ledger also catches the TS face widening past the mirror, so the reading moved in the direction of *more* diagnostics than predicted.
- **A4, restore the BASE union arm.** Predicted: 16 red. Observed: 17 failed, 58 passed.
  - The one I did not predict is the boundary row. With the arm back, an incomplete inline report is again read as `{ name }` and reported valid.
  - In the console pin, the `{ name }` refusal leg went red and the draw leg stayed green.

None names its `{ name }` arm. The rest do not mention `report`.
  - The 14 entries `check:changeset-claims` named for a touched file: none mentions the drill report.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx` casts `drillDown?.report as` a `Record` of `string` to `unknown` (or `undefined`). The cast is redundant now that the member has one arm, and it is harmless. Not in this claim's file surface. carrier: none.
- `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` gets no changeset entry. Its `src` changes only in a comment, so no behaviour ships, and the ruling's order names one `@object-ui/types` changeset.
